components.name: Local Project Registry Row
components.description: A flat local-project entry that keeps identity, path, and the explicit configuration state together without turning the registry into a card grid.
components.css: .ds-project-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 17px 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #202226; color: #eef0f4; text-align: left; background: transparent; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-project-row:hover { background: #121419; } .ds-project-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8ff78; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-project-row:active { background: #191b20; } .ds-project-folder { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #a8ff78; background: #1b211a; font-size: 16px; } .ds-project-identity { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; } .ds-project-identity strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-project-identity code { overflow: hidden; color: #969ba4; font: 10px/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-project-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #8d929c; font-size: 10px; } .ds-project-state i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7fe45b; }

components.name: Simulator Inventory Choice
components.description: A selectable all-available Simulator row with device identity and an explicit Booted or Shutdown label; the selected state remains tonal and compact.
components.css: .ds-simulator-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 11px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #3e4b38; border-radius: 11px; color: #eef0f4; text-align: left; background: #1b211a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(168 255 120 / 5%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-simulator-choice:hover { background: #20271e; } .ds-simulator-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8ff78; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-simulator-choice:active { background: #171c16; } .ds-simulator-icon { width: 18px; height: 28px; margin-left: 4px; border: 1.5px solid #92979f; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 -2px #92979f; } .ds-simulator-identity { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-simulator-identity strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-simulator-identity small { color: #969ba4; font-size: 10px; } .ds-simulator-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: #969ba4; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-simulator-status i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5f636b; } .ds-simulator-status.ds-booted { color: #a7d693; } .ds-simulator-status.ds-booted i { background: #7fe45b; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Commits a local primary operation such as connect, copy, export, or open selected live.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--primary-foreground); background: var(--primary); font: 700 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:hover { border-color: #b9ff94; background: #b9ff94; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Compact Tool Button
components.description: A precise secondary action for device, zoom, history, or workspace tools.
components.css: .ds-tool-button { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #34373d; border-radius: 7px; color: #b9bdc5; background: var(--muted); font: 600 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-button:hover { border-color: #50535a; color: var(--foreground); background: #202227; } .ds-tool-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-button:active { background: #292c31; }

components.name: Annotation Tool Active
components.description: The active rectangle, ellipse, text, or arrow tool; pink-red is confined to screenshot markup.
components.css: .ds-annotation-tool { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #ff6f84; border-radius: 7px; color: #fff0f2; background: #35191f; font: 600 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-annotation-tool:hover { color: #ffffff; background: #422027; } .ds-annotation-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-annotation-tool:active { background: #2c151a; }

components.name: Numbered Implementation Callout
components.description: A shape or arrow target connected by pink-red geometry to a matching editable implementation note. The same target, connector, number, type, and note are baked into the exported PNG.
components.css: .ds-callouts { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-callouts li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #3a3d44; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--foreground); background: #191b20; } .ds-callouts li > span { display: grid; width: 26px; height: 26px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: #11140f; background: #ff4d67; font: 800 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-callouts label { color: #a8abb3; font: 700 8px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-callouts textarea { width: 100%; border: 0; color: var(--foreground); background: transparent; font: 600 10px/1.35 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Workspace Mode Switch
components.description: A mutually exclusive Interact, Select, or Annotate control; choosing annotation freezes the current Simulator frame.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); width: 250px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 9px; background: #0f1013; } .ds-mode-option { min-height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: #858a93; background: transparent; font: 600 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode-option:hover { color: #d8dbe1; } .ds-mode-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mode-option-active { color: var(--primary-foreground); background: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); }

components.name: Evidence Request Field
components.description: Captures a local adjustment request while keeping source-changing action outside the workspace.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Adjustment request<textarea class="ds-evidence-field" placeholder="Describe what should change and what must stay intact…"></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: #d0d3d9; font: 650 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-field { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; padding: 10px 11px; border: 1px solid #383b42; border-radius: 9px; outline: none; color: var(--foreground); background: #181a1f; font: 400 12px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-field::placeholder { color: #747982; } .ds-evidence-field:hover { border-color: #50535a; } .ds-evidence-field:focus-visible { border-color: #769f61; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(168 255 120 / 10%); }

components.name: Floating Inspector
components.description: The fixed right-side instrument panel that keeps modes, evidence, prompt preparation, variants, and disconnect visible.

components.css: .ds-inspector { width: 344px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 15px; color: var(--foreground); background: #15171b; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgb(0 0 0 / 48%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-inspector header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px #292c31; } .ds-inspector header div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-inspector strong { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-inspector span, .ds-inspector small { color: #858a93; font-size: 9px; } .ds-inspector section { padding: 15px 18px; } .ds-inspector b { font-size: 11px; } .ds-inspector p { margin: 11px 0 0; color: #8d929c; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-inspector:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgb(0 0 0 / 48%), 0 0 0 1px rgb(168 255 120 / 18%); }

components.name: Canvas Zoom Instrument
components.description: The lower-left zoom palette exposes 25–200% scaling and fit while direct canvas gestures handle pan and modifier-wheel zoom.
components.html: 75%
components.css: .ds-zoom-instrument { display: flex; height: 38px; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border-radius: 10px; color: #aeb2ba; background: #191b1f; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / 38%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-zoom-instrument button { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: inherit; background: transparent; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-zoom-instrument button:hover { color: #fff; background: #292c31; } .ds-zoom-instrument button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-zoom-instrument button:active { background: #30333a; } .ds-zoom-instrument output { width: 45px; color: #8d929c; font-size: 9px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; } .ds-zoom-instrument .ds-fit { width: auto; margin-left: 3px; padding: 0 8px; box-shadow: inset 1px 0 #303238; border-radius: 0 7px 7px 0; }

components.name: Variant Evidence Tile
components.description: A captured native variant that remains evidence until explicitly opened live and never implies a source change.
components.css: .ds-variant-tile { display: grid; width: 190px; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--foreground); text-align: left; background: #15171b; cursor: pointer; } .ds-variant-tile > span:first-child { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-variant-tile strong { font: 650 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-variant-tile small { color: #858a93; font: 400 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-variant-frame { display: grid; min-height: 180px; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; color: #62666f; background: var(--background); font: 400 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-variant-tile:hover { border-color: #4b4f56; background: #181a1f; } .ds-variant-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-variant-tile:active { border-color: #79b05e; background: #1b211a; box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgb(0 0 0 / 28%); }

components.description: A compact accessibility selection card; ordinary elements are green and containers switch to cyan.
components.css: .ds-runtime-selection { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #526547; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--foreground); background: #1b211a; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-runtime-selection strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-runtime-selection span, .ds-runtime-selection code { color: #969ba4; font-size: 10px; } .ds-runtime-selection code { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace; } .ds-runtime-container { border-color: #417087; background: #162127; } .ds-runtime-selection:hover { border-color: #7dd3fc; } .ds-runtime-selection:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(125 211 252 / 16%); }

narrative.overview:
Monad Design Desktop is a dense, dark Operate workspace that moves from local project context to one visual authority: the real iOS Simulator frame. The home begins as a flat registry of explicitly chosen local projects; entering a project reveals the full available Simulator inventory; once connected, the application becomes an artifact-first free canvas. Across those states, brand expression comes from disciplined state color, compact proportions, and precise spacing rather than ornamental graphics.

Before connection, rows and status labels behave like a native local inventory rather than a dashboard of cards. Project configuration, Simulator boot state, loading, and iPad pairing remain visible at the point of action. After connection, controls behave like local instruments around the artifact: device controls sit immediately below the Simulator; zoom floats at the canvas edge; the inspector anchors to the right; comparison and annotation replace the canvas content without pretending to change source. Copy such as “Configured locally,” “Configuration written only after you choose a directory,” “Prepared locally · not sent,” and “Preview evidence only” is part of the visual hierarchy because it keeps registration, preparation, preview, export, and source-changing action visibly distinct.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral canvas and restrained tonal surfaces
Flat local project registry with explicit configuration-write boundaries
Scroll-contained all-available Simulator inventory with visible boot state
Real Simulator imagery as the dominant artifact
Compact floating controls with clear active, disabled, loading, and error states
Acid green reserved for primary, live, selected, and ready states
Pink-red reserved for screenshot annotation ink and its active tools
Cyan reserved for container-level accessibility evidence

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Acid green means live, selected, ready, or primary; cyan means container evidence; pink-red means annotation. Do not interchange these roles.

rules.name: The Local Boundary Rule
rules.body: Preparation and preview surfaces must visibly state whether work stays local, is evidence only, or has not been applied to source.

rules.name: The Artifact First Rule
rules.body: Type supports operating context and evidence; it never becomes a display spectacle larger than the real Simulator artifact.

rules.name: The Artifact Dominance Rule
rules.body: Preserve clear area around the Simulator or frozen capture. The fit calculation must reserve the right operations lane and cap at 200% of the device's logical size; floating tools may overlap the canvas ground, never the evidence itself.

rules.name: The Registry Before Runtime Rule
rules.body: Keep project selection flat and local, then reveal Simulator inventory only inside the chosen project. The registry, device list, and their loading or empty states scroll within their assigned regions instead of pushing boundary copy or the primary action out of view.

rules.name: The Floating Instrument Rule
rules.body: Apply a large shadow only when a surface is spatially detached from the canvas or artifact. Ordinary sections remain flat and separated tonally.

rules.name: The Compact Geometry Rule
rules.body: Small radii belong to tools; large radii belong to devices and floating workspaces. Do not inflate every control into a soft capsule.

dos: **Do** keep the real Simulator frame, capture, runtime geometry, and device identity visually primary.
**Do** keep the home registry flat, show project path and “Configured locally” on each row, and keep the configuration-write boundary visible.
**Do** show all available Simulators with explicit Booted or Shutdown labels and use “Connect” versus “Start & connect” according to the selected device state.
**Do** use acid green for primary/live/selected states, pink-red for annotation, and cyan for container evidence.
**Do** keep controls compact, keyboard reachable, clearly labeled, and understandable without color alone.
**Do** state local preparation, preview-only evidence, download initiation, and errors in visible text.
**Do** keep annotation, variant comparison, selection, and direct interaction mutually exclusive where the implementation makes them exclusive.
**Do** preserve original-resolution Simulator pixels, image-relative annotation geometry, and one-to-one numbering between every callout target and exported note.
**Do** fit from logical Simulator dimensions, reserve the right operations lane, and cap automatic or manual zoom at 200%.
**Do** keep “Prepared locally · not sent” adjacent to prompt preparation, not buried in secondary help text.
donts: **Don't** present a preview, selection, annotation, copied prompt, or captured frame as a source-code change.
**Don't** present choosing a project directory as source modification; name the `.monaddesign/project.json` write and state that source is unchanged.
**Don't** hide the project loading row, collapse the Simulator inventory to booted devices only, or let its scroll push the connection action out of view.
**Don't** reuse annotation pink-red as a general brand accent or container cyan as a generic highlight.
**Don't** add bright decorative surfaces that compete with the native app imagery.
**Don't** turn every section into an elevated card; reserve large shadows for detached canvas instruments.
**Don't** hide loading, disabled, empty, capture, clipboard, export, or stream failure states.
**Don't** let floating controls cover the Simulator or frozen capture.
**Don't** detach device controls from the Simulator cluster or move the zoom instruments out of the lower-left canvas corner.
